blocks.text: When Damian Lillard tore his left Achilles tendon during the playoffs two seasons ago, he recalls that a television pundit said the injury would be the end of his career. Never doubt Dame. Lillard returns this season for the Portland Trail Blazers after spending some 16 months rehabbing the injury he sustained while playing for the Milwaukee Bucks. “I remember the night that I did it.
